description: This file contains the definition of the Transfer class responsible for managing file uploads and downloads between local filesystem and Amazon S3, supporting features like multipart uploads, progress callbacks, debugging, and URL scheme validation.

classes.name: Transfer
classes.description: Handles transferring files to and from S3 or local filesystem, including multipart uploads, with configurable concurrency, callbacks, and debugging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Transfer object with source, destination, client, and options, validating schemes and preparing parameters.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that represents the ongoing transfer operation.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Performs the transfer synchronously by waiting on the promise.

methods.name: prepareTarget
methods.description: Prepares and normalizes the target path, determining scheme and validating it.

methods.name: getS3Args
methods.description: Parses an S3 URI into its bucket and key components.

methods.name: determineScheme
methods.description: Determines the scheme ('file' or 's3') of a given path.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a filesystem path to use UNIX style separators and removes trailing slashes.

methods.name: resolvesOutsideTargetDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a given sink path and object key resolve outside the intended target directory (security check).

methods.name: createDownloadPromise
methods.description: Creates a promise that handles downloading multiple objects from S3.

methods.name: createUploadPromise
methods.description: Creates a promise that handles uploading files to S3, including multipart uploads.

methods.name: getUploadsIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over files to upload, either from a directory or provided iterator.

methods.name: getDownloadsIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over files to download from S3.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Performs a single file upload to S3.

methods.name: uploadMultipart
methods.description: Performs a multipart upload for large files.

methods.name: createS3Key
methods.description: Generates the S3 object key for a given filename relative to the source path.

methods.name: addDebugToBefore
methods.description: Adds debugging output to the 'before' hook for transfer commands, logging source and destination paths.
